sourceTitle: The Laurel Bush: An Old-Fashioned Love Story
description: "The Laurel Bush: An Old-Fashioned Love Story" by Dinah Maria Mulock Craik is a novel written in the mid-19th century. The story revolves around the lives of two lonely young people—Fortune Williams, a governess, and Robert Roy, a tutor—who find themselves drawn to each other amidst their daily duties, exploring themes of love, isolation, and societal expectations.
